title: Lior and the Blue Hour
author: Noor Thackeray
blurb: Odile Dravenmoor, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
